18 more days until Election Day!! Honored to have [image: 18 more days until Election Day!! Honored to have the endorsement of California State Senator Bob Archuleta, a proud U.S. Army veteran, former Mayor of Pico Rivera, and dedicated public servant! Senator Archuleta has been a strong advocate for veterans, public safety, working families, and economic opportunity. His decades of service reflect his commitment to making our communities stronger and ensuring that every Californian has a chance to succeed. Thank you, Senator Archuleta, for your friendship, leadership, and continued service to California! 🇺🇸 #SenatorBobArchuleta #CaliforniaSenate #Veterans #PublicSafety #WorkingFamilies #CaliforniaLeadership #StrongerTogether]

Grateful to have the support of California State S [image: Grateful to have the support of California State Senator María Elena Durazo! Senator Durazo has spent her life fighting for working families. From the labor movement to the State Senate, she has been a powerful voice for her district and for communities across Los Angeles. 🌎🐋💚 Thank you Jiah Miesel, Founder of San Diego Ea [image: 🌎🐋💚 Thank you Jiah Miesel, Founder of San Diego Earth Day, Whale Day, and Planet Love Day! What an inspiring example of how one person’s passion can make a difference! Through his dedication to environmental awareness, ocean conservation, and spreading love for our planet, Jiah is bringing communities together to celebrate and protect the natural world. From protecting our majestic whales 🐋 to encouraging everyday acts of kindness toward Mother Earth 🌱, his message reminds us that every day is an opportunity to show our planet some love! Thank you, Jiah, for your vision, leadership, and commitment to making our world a better place for future generations! 🌎❤️ #JiahMiesel #SanDiegoEarthDay #WhaleDay #PlanetLoveDay #OceanConservation #ProtectOurPlanet #EnvironmentalLeadership #Sustainability #California]

🔎 Mystery Solved! 💰🎓 Our amazing volunteer Youth [image: 🔎 Mystery Solved! 💰🎓 Our amazing volunteer Youth Ambassadors, Maya and Claire, are on a mission to uncover California’s best-kept secret: FREE MONEY for college and career training through CalKIDS! 💵 These young leaders are spreading the word, empowering their peers, and encouraging students and families to “CLAIM YOUR FREE MONEY!” 🙌 Eligible students can receive $500–$1,500 to help pay for college, community college, or vocational training. No essays, no applications, and no minimum GPA required to claim an existing award! 👏 A huge THANK YOU to Maya and Claire for helping unlock opportunities and making higher education more affordable! 🔗 Check your eligibility and claim your money at CalKIDS.org. #CalKIDS #ClaimYourFreeMoney #YouthAmbassadors #CollegeSavings #StudentSuccess #HigherEducation #CaliforniaDream #FutureLeaders #FinancialEmpowerment @calkidsprogram @caltreasurer]
